children: The predict.fun market for the LCK final between HLE and GEN shows GEN with a 64% chance of defeating HLE. According to Odaily, the 2026 LCK final will begin at 1 p.m. at Seoul's KSPO DOME in a best-of-five series.

GEN previously beat HLE 3-1 in the winners' bracket final to reach the championship match, while HLE advanced from the losers' bracket after defeating T1 3-1 yesterday. GEN has won the last three meetings between the two teams, including two best-of-three matches in August and the 3-1 winners' bracket final on September 5.
If GEN wins again, it will complete back-to-back LCK titles under the league's single-season format. HLE must beat GEN for the second time in a week to win this year's LCK championship.

title: GEN Seen With 64% Chance to Beat HLE in predict.fun LCK Final Market
